title: An inbound email claims a milestone number that doesn't exist
author: kothar-wa-khasis
description: The hundred-first real recipe, and the fifth to read gmail (after email-claims-unfixed-issue, email-dangling-reference, email-claims-unmerged-pr, and email-claims-open-milestone). Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (the shared seam_engine.milestone_claims grammar twenty-five sibling recipes already import) from an inbound email's own body and checks whether the named milestone exists at all -- not whether a real milestone's claim is TRUE (email-claims-open-milestone's own remit), but whether the number the claim names resolves to anything real. Closes the one leg the email family had never grown: every other claims-* source in this engine (issue-body, issue-comment, linear-comment, mention, readme, review-comment, slack-message) already carries all five legs of its own family (claims-dangling-milestone, claims-open-milestone, claims-unfixed-issue, claims-unmerged-pr, dangling-reference); email was stuck at four. Genuinely distinct from email-dangling-reference: milestones and issues/PRs are separate GitHub number spaces, so a #N that is a real issue could still be a dangling milestone claim, and email-dangling-reference never opens ListMilestones at all. Fixture-only, MOCK ONLY, never a live network call -- the-hand gateway's connected Google account carries gmail.readonly among its granted OAuth scopes, but exposes zero Gmail-capable tools on the live gateway today, same WIP note every other email recipe already carries. Neither scope is new (ListMilestones sat on the oath table from founding; ListEmails has sat on the Gmail row since ROADMAP.md #16) and gmail+github is not a new toolkit pair (email-claims-unfixed-issue already proposed it).
confidence_notes: Flat 0.8, not age-gated -- mirrors every other *-claims-dangling-milestone sibling's own reasoning rather than email-claims-open-milestone's 24-hour edit-grace bar: an OPEN milestone could close at any moment, so a fresh claim about it might just be a race the email hasn't caught up to yet, but a milestone number that does not exist right now will not spontaneously start existing later, so there is no grace period that means anything here. A claimed milestone number that DOES resolve to a real milestone is excluded at confidence 0.0 regardless of whether that milestone is open or closed -- whether the claim is true is email-claims-open-milestone's own seam, not this one's. An email with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all (a bare #N aside) produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken. Fixture-only (source: "fixture") per SCOPES.md's own WIP note on the gmail toolkit: the-hand gateway's connected Google account carries gmail.readonly among its granted OAuth scopes, but exposes zero Gmail-capable tools on its live toolset today -- the detection logic is real, the live read waits on the Hand's gateway, and only the fixture loader swaps for a real call the day one appears.
